summary: Specifies how calendaring systems use iCalendar objects to interoperate for scheduling events, busy time, to-dos and journal entries. It is independent of the transport used to carry them. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 5546.

eli5.summary: This is the set of polite messages calendars use to invite each other to meetings, accept, decline or suggest changes.

questions: how do calendars schedule meetings with each other
